_extracted_from: Astrobotic Lunar Landers Payload User's Guide (2021), https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/astrobotic-lunar-landers-pug.pdf
_method: AI-assisted extraction (Claude) with page citation for every value, then human review. Values not in the document are left null and returned by the engine as requirements.

duration_days.src: PUG p24: surface operations duration up to 14 days

earliest_landing_utc.src: press: launch NET late 2026; cruise 3-33 d + lunar orbit 4-25 d (PUG p52) - to confirm

ellipse_radius_m.src: PUG p51: OPAL improves accuracy to a 100 m x 100 m ellipse

max_slope_deg.src: PUG p51: sites selected with effective slope <= 10 deg

max_rock_size_m.src: PUG p51: max expected rock height 0.3 m preferred

earth_visible_at_landing.src: PUG p30: lander-Earth link in X-band (direct to Earth)

panels.src: PUG p24: side-mounted solar panels for polar missions; four sides assumed from the square deck - power not given

battery_wh.src: PUG p28: lithium-ion battery, capacity not given

load_operations_w.src: PUG p5: 1.0 W per kg of payload x 625 kg (p24) - payload power only

mode.src: PUG p30: X-band uplink and downlink with Earth

ground_stations.src: PUG p48: ground stations, network to confirm

data_rate_kbps.src: PUG p5/p56: 10 kbps per kg x 625 kg

surface_range_c.src: PUG p36: lunar surface -30 C to 80 C (excludes lunar night)
